name: A Series of Unfortunate Events
description: The orphaned Baudelaire children face trials, tribulations and the evil Count Olaf, all in their quest to uncover the secret of their parents' death.

videos.title: The Bad Beginning (1)
videos.overview: The dreadful history of the Baudelaire children begins with a deadpan narrator, a terrible fire and the ominous arrival of a distant relative.

videos.title: The Bad Beginning (2)
videos.overview: While Mr. Poe's secretary works overtime, Count Olaf casts Violet and Klaus in "The Marvelous Marriage," a work of theater with alarming implications.

videos.title: The Reptile Room (1)
videos.overview: After the Baudelaires move in with Dr. Montgomery, a renowned expert in reptile behavior, their new guardian hires a frighteningly familiar assistant.

videos.title: The Reptile Room (2)
videos.overview: Klaus and Violet suspect Count Olaf and his evil cohorts when a lifeless body turns up in the reptile room. Sunny sees the inside of a suitcase.

videos.title: The Wide Window (1)
videos.overview: The orphans arrive at the aptly named Lake Lachrymose to meet their widowed Aunt Josephine, a strict grammarian who's haunted by the past.

videos.title: The Wide Window (2)
videos.overview: Klaus and Violet look for clues in a suspicious note that passes custody to Captain Sham, a seafaring scam artist with clear ties to Count Olaf.

videos.title: The Miserable Mill (1)
videos.overview: The children arrive at the Lucky Smells Lumber Mill and unearth some unsettling accusations about their parents. Count Olaf courts an old flame.

videos.title: The Miserable Mill (2)
videos.overview: Klaus just isn't himself after seeing Dr. Orwell, an optometrist with oddly optimistic patients. Meanwhile, Violet works to clear her parents' names.

videos.title: The Austere Academy (1)
videos.overview: The Baudelaires begin life at boarding school and meet a pair of mysterious siblings whose tragic lives sound eerily similar to their own.

videos.title: The Austere Academy (2)
videos.overview: While the Quagmires keep up the search, the Baudelaires struggle to balance their studies with a punishing workout schedule, courtesy of Count Olaf.

videos.title: The Ersatz Elevator (1)
videos.overview: Violet, Klaus and Sunny get new guardians in a fashionable building, where stairs are in -- and the elevator's out. Jacques Snicket trains a recruit.

videos.title: The Ersatz Elevator (2)
videos.overview: The Baudelaires find their friends -- and then lose them -- at the bottom of an elevator shaft. Count Olaf conducts an auction in disguise.

videos.title: The Vile Village (1)
videos.overview: Mr. Poe brings the Baudelaires to V.F.D., a bird-loving village with an Old West vibe. Jacques and Olivia continue their search for the Quagmires.

videos.title: The Vile Village (2)
videos.overview: The orphans find themselves under suspicion in the wake of a devastating murder. But time behind bars leads to an important realization.

videos.title: The Hostile Hospital (1)
videos.overview: Life on the lam leads the Baudelaires to a horrifying hospital with an enormous library that could hold the answers to all of their questions.

videos.title: The Hostile Hospital (2)
videos.overview: A bearded Klaus and Sunny comb the hospital's crumbling halls for Violet, who's being held prisoner under Count Olaf's questionable "care."

videos.title: Carnivorous Carnival (1)
videos.overview: Come one, come all to the creepiest circus the world has ever seen, a place where puzzling mysteries -- and a familiar face -- await.

videos.title: Carnivorous Carnival (2)
videos.overview: Still posing as conjoined carnival freaks, the Baudelaires brace themselves for a beastly fate. Will good fortune intervene ... for once?

videos.title: Slippery Slope (1)
videos.overview: While Count Olaf makes his way to V.F.D. headquarters with Sunny, Klaus and Violet are exactly where we left them: careening toward the edge of a cliff.

videos.title: Slippery Slope (2)
videos.overview: Sunny sends a signal from Count Olaf's camp, where a sinister duo is awakening old insecurities. A clue at V.F.D. HQ points the way to a fateful meeting.

videos.title: Grim Grotto (1)
videos.overview: A young submarine captain with ties to the V.F.D. reveals she's looking for the sugar bowl. But so is Esmé Squalor, who's on a mission to find it first.

videos.title: Grim Grotto (2)
videos.overview: With Sunny's fate hanging in the balance, Violet and Klaus race to find a life-saving antidote and learn the location of the Last Safe Place.

videos.title: Penultimate Peril (1)
videos.overview: Various parties converge at the Hotel Denouement, where the mysterious "J.S." has called the V.F.D. together -- and things aren't always what they seem.

videos.title: Penultimate Peril (2)
videos.overview: Big secrets are revealed when Count Olaf goes on trial in the hotel lobby. The Baudelaires are the first to take the stand, but will justice be served?

videos.title: The End
videos.overview: The final chapter takes the orphans to a deserted island: a place of lost lives, old stories and new beginnings. It all ends here.

awards: Nominated for 6 Primetime Emmys. 19 wins & 47 nominations total
